fato_historico: 1993: Two earthquakes affect New Zealand. A 7.0 Mw shock (intensity VI (Strong)) in the South Island was followed nine hours later by a 6.4 Mw event (intensity VII (Very strong)) in the North Island.
energia_do_dia: The earth shifts beneath your feet today, much like the tremors of change that reshape islands. You may find that your routine feels slightly unsteady, but consider this a call to ground yourself deeper. It is a good time to release rigid expectations and embrace the transformative power of flexibility while navigating your daily journey with grace.
frase_do_dia: Even when the ground beneath you shakes, your inner foundation remains unshakable and calm.
significado_numero: Represents the pursuit of truth and the wisdom found in stability.
conselho: Stay grounded, breathe deeply, and welcome the unexpected changes with an open heart.
